name: web-extractor
summary: Extract the main body text of web pages (strip nav/ads/footers) and optionally summarize it — 网页正文抓取与摘要. Use when you need to fetch a page's clean readable content given a URL, pull article/news/blog text out of cluttered pages, batch-extract multiple pages to Markdown, or summarize a web article's key points. Triggered on: 抓网页正文、提取文章内容、网页转md、链接提取正文、批量抓取文章、网页摘要、总结链接内容、把网址内容整理出来.
